method: Auto-sourced from official structured data: UNCTAD TRAINS non-tariff measures (HS 170220, imports from Canada), national tariff schedules (UK Trade Tariff API, EU TARIC, Japan Customs, Australian Border Force, US HTS) and WITS/TRAINS applied tariffs, plus the FDA and CFIA pages cited per requirement. Not checked by a person for this product.

GB.tariff_note: UK Trade Tariff (commodity 1702209090, maple syrup): 0% tariff preference for Canada under the UK-Canada Trade Continuity Agreement; 8% third-country duty without it.
GB.tax_note: UK Trade Tariff lists 0% VAT on this commodity.

requirements.name: CUKTCA origin declaration on the invoice
requirements.detail: To claim the 0% preference, the exporter provides an origin declaration on the invoice or another commercial document that describes the product (UK Trade Tariff rules of origin, UK-Canada TCA).

notes: UK Trade Tariff lists no sanitary or phytosanitary import control for maple syrup from Canada. An organic certificate of inspection (C644) is needed only if the product is sold as organic.
CFIA's export requirements library has no maple syrup entry for the UK (checked 2026-09-26).

requirements.name: CIFER establishment and product registration (self-registration)
requirements.detail: CFIA: low-risk food establishments must create a profile in China's CIFER system and apply for product registration themselves (CFIA is not involved); products made before the registration approval date may not be exported. GACC's review time is unpredictable.

requirements.name: China registration number on packaging
requirements.detail: CFIA: the GACC-issued China registration number or the CFIA-issued establishment number must appear on inner and outer packaging.

notes: CFIA: ask the Chinese importer whether a CFIA export certificate is required.
